verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on agent, so web-grounded research answers are a fair question for it. The evidence only says it has its own cloud browser and can log into websites. Nothing documents that it answers questions from current web results or cites its sources, so the browser is at most an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources
